instructions.content: Write the smallest failing test that expresses one behavior.
Run tests and verify the failure is for the expected reason.
Implement minimal code to make the test pass.
Refactor while keeping the suite green.
Repeat the cycle for the next behavior or edge case.
NEVER implement feature code before writing a failing test.
NEVER test implementation details instead of behavior; assert observable output.
NEVER combine multiple behaviors into one test case; one behavior per test.
NEVER use arbitrary sleeps in unit tests; synchronise with deterministic signals.
Use TDD for unit test design, behavior-driven assertions and mock/stub isolation strategy.
Do not use this skill for full E2E harness setup, performance benchmarking or security testing.
Apply naming and organisation conventions that keep tests maintainable.
Reproduce a bug with a failing test before fixing it.
Run the suite with bun test, bun test --watch, or a specific file path while iterating.
